text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So that's the end of summer camp… I guess it went all right.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The end of summer means autumn is just around the corner. And you know what that means…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yep, exactly. And I've got a score to settle…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's still time before the big race. We should go back through everything we've done so far, cover to cover.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'll ever let her take first place!
